learning_extracted: Criterion-isolation rule: a raw 'labels differ' fraction over N categories is confounded by the (N-1)/N baseline mismatch; the PASS bar must sit above where the matched negative control lands, or the within-eval control-difference must itself be load-bearing.
The within-eval drive-dependence control (WL_drive - WL_nodrive) must be load-bearing for MECH-229, not merely reported.
A PASS on a non-isolating criterion is as untrustworthy as the FAIL; the 514o supports + the promotion built on it must be re-examined, not just the 514p FAIL.
